Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when the answer is a replay of the stored answer of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

reasonCode.description: The return reason of an AUTHORIZED RMA.

rejectionCode.description: Why a REQUESTED RMA was rejected: LINE_NOT_MANIFESTED, RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED, OPEN_RMA_EXISTS or QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_POLICY.

status.description:
Lifecycle state of an RMA. `REJECTED` and `CLOSED` are terminal:
nothing leaves them.
status.title: ReturnStatus

windowEndsAt.description: The last instant goods may arrive; present once AUTHORIZED.

receivedAt.description: When the first receipt moved the RMA to RECEIVED.

version.description: Starts at 1, +1 per accepted transition; guards every write (409 on a lost update).

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, a NUL byte in the body, or an invalid path, query or header parameter.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

malformedBody.summary: Malformed JSON body, unknown field or NUL byte

value.title: Malformed request body
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Quantity is invalid
value.detail: quantity must be an integer of at least 1

invalidLine.summary: A receipt line is not MATCHED or UNEXPECTED

value.title: Receipt line is invalid
value.detail: every line must be kind MATCHED with an rmaId, or kind UNEXPECTED

value.title: Grade is invalid
value.detail: grade must be one of A, B, C, SCRAP

value.title: Disposition policy is invalid
value.detail: every grade needs a productClass "*" default rule and maxUnitsPerLine must be at least 1

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is invalid
value.detail: the Idempotency-Key header must be 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters

value.title: limit is invalid
value.detail: limit must be an integer between 1 and 500

value.title: cursor is invalid
value.detail: cursor is not a cursor issued by this API

409.description: The resource is in the wrong state for the command, another request changed it first, or the Idempotency-Key was reused.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.

lineNotManifested.summary: The order line never provably shipped

value.title: The order line is not authorizable
value.detail: RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED: the return window ends before now

quantityExceedsPolicy.summary: The quantity passes the policy cap

value.title: The order line is not authorizable
value.detail: QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_POLICY: quantity must be at most maxUnitsPerLine

openRmaExists.summary: Another RMA is already open for this order line

value.title: An RMA is already open for this order line
value.detail: one open RMA per (orderRef, lineNo); close or receive the open one first

rmaNotAuthorizableState.summary: The RMA cannot receive goods in its state

value.title: The receipt line is already inspected

inspectedExceedsReceived.summary: The inspected quantity passes the received quantity
